purpose: Transparent annual model for three guest-house suites; not an accountant, payroll, tax, bank or legal forecast

glossary.property_company: Société civile immobilière CSL, owner of the château
glossary.operating_company: Future commercial company operating the guest house
glossary.shareholder_current_account: Interest-free associate advance recorded as a debt of the operating company
glossary.average_public_nightly_price: Average public tax-inclusive price for one suite and one night

signature_table.commercial_rule: One menu, advance booking, one fixed service time and deliberately limited service days.

tax.warning: Rates, mixed supplies, deduction rights and invoicing require professional validation.

staffing.warning: Annual capacity does not replace a weekly roster respecting rests, leave and simultaneous services.

property_rent.reference_rule: The rent must be supported by market value and the lease. An 18,000 EUR rent makes the operating company cash-negative in the reference financing case even though consolidated cash is unchanged.

operating_company_shareholder_current_ac.repayment_condition: Only when cash permits; blocking, deferral or subordination behind bank debt may be required.

investment_and_financing.allocation_rule: The SCI should fund property-incorporated works; the operating company should fund detachable furniture, operating equipment and working capital. Actual invoices control the final allocation.

calculation_rules.operating_result_before_rent: accounting_revenue - variable_costs - fixed_operating_costs - Jules employer budget - paid support
calculation_rules.operating_company_cash_after_financing: operating_company_cash_before_financing - operating-company shareholder-current-account principal - operating-company bank debt service
calculation_rules.property_company_cash_before_existing_co: property rent received - new SCI bank debt service
calculation_rules.simplified_total_debt_service_coverage: project_cash_before_new_financing / (shareholder-current-account principal + new bank debt service)
calculation_rules.warning: The consolidated calculation excludes undisclosed existing SCI debt service and costs; it is not a lender covenant.

validation_register: Confirm that the three suites remain within the guest-house five-room and fifteen-guest limits and update the municipal declaration or registration.
Confirm VAT treatment and rates before contracts and pricing are frozen.
Obtain payroll validation for Jules and quotes for 1,175 paid-support hours.
Replace fixed and variable costs with quotes, invoices and dry-run measurements.
Create a named weekly roster for Jules, paid support and no more than 200 associate hours.
Allocate each item of the 80,000 EUR envelope to the SCI or operating company from the actual invoice and asset owner.
Obtain two bank offers and validate borrower, fees, insurance, guarantees and repayment profile.
Review all existing SCI debt service and costs in a restricted banking annex before approving SCI borrowing.
Document the interest-free 20,000 EUR shareholder current account, including blocking, deferral or subordination behind bank debt.
Validate the 12,000 EUR rent against market value and each entity's standalone cash.
